options.name: Harbour Standard
options.detail: A — HARBOUR STANDARD. Contemporary harbour signage and refined nautical instrument panels. Muted deep petrol/navy #14262C, slate teal #29444B, warm bone text #E5DFCF, restrained aged ochre/brass #B7925C used ONLY for primary action and focus. Squared rectangular control plates with slight1-2px corner ease and one small clipped corner; matte solid panels, fine precision rules. Condensed bold sans wordmark, humanist clear body type, tabular score numerals. Dark but text legible, side navigation rows, strongly filled ochre Play Solo button with ink text, quiet but physically distinct teal Play Online plate. Avoid faux pirate wood; tiny nautical chart tick marks confined to decorative margins. Character backdrop a dusky teal harbor with existing warm lantern light only. HUD: thin ink panels with fine bone edge, coral red/smoke blue team marks and names, plain horizontal health meter. Premium grounded restrained yet playful original game. Most balanced candidate.
options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one professional high-fidelity UI art direction concept board for Hook Wars, an original voxel river team hook-brawler for browser and Steam. Input image1 is the current Steam main menu, EDIT TARGET for replacement interface; image2 is current gameplay, supporting reference for an inset HUD. Preserve the identifiable chunky original barrel-bodied Dredge-Bot Lunker, hook arm and dock/river setting; retain voxel construction and original game identity, not a realistic human or any Warcraft character. Redesign the interface comprehensively. Landscape 16:9 image around2048x1152 with a narrow editorial header and two large side-by-side screen mockups: MAIN MENU left about60%width and GAMEPLAY HUD right40%width, visibly separate so both screens can be judged. Menu has large two-word 'HOOK WARS' logo, prominent 'Play Solo' and 'Play Online' buttons, quieter 'Locker', 'Store', 'Market', 'Career' navigation, 'Settings', 'How to Play', compact profile 'Mudlark88' and '500 Pearls', Steam-specific smaller 'Play with Steam' action. Put voxel Dredge-Bot visibly on right part of MENU viewport without obstructing text. HUD viewport is actual isometric voxel bank-and-river match: compact top 'RED TIDE  1', '14:11', '0  BLUE GILL'; small explicit 'DEEP WATER' caution; minimal lower health '1000 / 1000', three clearly labeled square-ish skills 'Chain Hook', 'Grapple', 'Belly Bash' with 'LMB','RMB','SPACE', four numbered item slots and '547 Gold'; compact minimap in corner. HUD must leave center clear, all controls sit at edges. Consistent design system in both previews. Verbatim small header 'UI CONCEPT • NOT IMPLEMENTED'. Include concept name and letter in editorial header. One narrow palette strip at bottom with4colorchips. Clear readable substantial typography, confident spacing, crisp line icons with labels, unmistakable controls, strong focus state on one menu action. No illegible fake paragraph text, no invented ranked mode/season/battle pass/player counts/purchase promises. NO neon, NO purple SaaS gradients, NO glassmorphism, NO pill-shaped buttons, NO glossy inflated plastic, NO enormous soft drop shadows, NO shiny gold beveled borders, NO ornamental ropes around every panel, NO floating dashboard card collage. Remove current orange/gold button system. No borrowed brand marks or logos. It must feel bespoke and thoughtfully art-directed, feasible as code-native CSS and SVG. options.name: Chartroom
options.detail: B — CHARTROOM. An unusually tasteful light maritime chart-table interface. Soft desaturated oat/chart paper #D9D2BE and warm ivory #F0EBDE on most UI surfaces, deep marine ink #20373A typography, muted red oxide #92513E as restrained action accent. NOT bright white. Flat sharp rectangular paper tabs, thin straight chart rules, tiny coordinate ticks, slight paper stock texture visible ONLY in blank margin, absolutely no antique stains or scrapbook clutter. Handsome compact editorial slab-serif 'HOOK WARS' wordmark, highly legible sans-serif labels/body. Menu asymmetrical chart grid, left ink navigation on warm matte chart background, right Dredge-Bot showcase in clean framed voxel dock viewport. Solid dark marine Play Solo bar with ivory text, clearly shaped secondary buttons. HUD compact cream plates with dark text and muted team marker labels, fully opaque enough for visibility; minimap feels like actual navigation chart, ability icons simple ink drawing with squarekeycaps. Elegant readable welcoming, distinct from typical dark gaming interfaces. Clear UI on dark game world. No gold/glow, no brown wooden chest panels.

options.name: Iron Dock
options.detail: C — IRON DOCK. Modern industrial dock-control hardware adapted to playful voxel combat, like original crane console instrumentation. Charcoal #1B2125, desaturated steel #3C474C, chalk/offwhite #E2E1D7 text, weathered burnt copper #A75F43 accent; muted warm steel-not-cyberpunk. Distinctive straight rectangular or single chamfered corner buttons,4px solid side tabs, very subtle pressed edges, fine stencil glyph identifiers, disciplined grid. Strong narrow technical sans display face with softer clear sans body, large legible numbers; absolutely no microscopic sci-fi interface. Vertical main menu stacked flush rows, copper filled Play Solo, secondary steel filled PlayOnline, compact equipmentnav. Character presentation integrated with existing Dredge-Bot voxel harbor machinery. UI mostly matte finish with subtle material only at edges. HUD compact tool-strip rectangular squares, coolsteel dividers, thin readable healthbar, highcontrast team symbols and labels. A little rugged personality without dirt, rivet overload, hazardstripe overload or dystopian guns. No glowing accents, no realistic gun shooter redesign, no long scratches under text.

options.name: Regatta
options.detail: D — REGATTA. Contemporary graphic-design-led sailing club poster and competition scoreboard aesthetic, a confidently unusual indie game UI. Restrained near-black slate #2A303A, cream #D9D4C5, muted brick burgundy #8D443F, desaturated sailgreen #788675. Very clean flat bold rectangular shapes and thin rules, square corners, a distinct small signal-flag triangular notch on primary action. Large custom-looking block/squared HOOK WARS wordmark, strong editorial typographic scale, mixed uppercase section headers and readable natural-case action text. Cream typography on large solid slate/navy left menu area, warm cream header/bottom utility rail, brick PlaySolo block with cream text, simple sage/ink PlayOnline control. Few well-chosen oversized monochrome nautical pictograms, not random emoji. Character is existing chunky voxel Dredge-Bot on roomy dock showcase. Layout slightly more graphic/asymmetric than others but organized and clean. HUD a very minimal sailing scorecard header, typographic tabular scores, red/blue teams labeled and symbol-coded, rectangular abilitytiles, low clutter. Personality comes from typography and proportions, not heavy texture or glow. Avoid esports neon, black-red gamer trope, marketingwebsite hero copy or excessive slogans.
